title: Prism SQLite store (instrument + valuation_daily)
key_findings: modernc.org/sqlite v1.38.2 已在 go.mod,未升级;go.mod 未改动
覆盖率 80.6%(7 用例全 PASS),未覆盖行集中于 Open schema 初始化失败/sql.Open 失败等错误分支——DoD non_functional 明确标注这些难单测分支用审查覆盖(verify_by: review)
NaN↔NULL 约定落地:toNull(内存 NaN → SQL NULL)/fromNull(NULL → math.NaN());非 NaN 值往返一致
valuation_daily 用 WITHOUT ROWID + PRIMARY KEY(instrument_id,d);instrument 用 UNIQUE(symbol,type) 支持幂等 upsert

decisions.rationale: WAL 支持并发读写、busy_timeout 5s 避免锁竞争即时失败;与计划 Task 2 一致

decisions.decision: Open 用 os.MkdirAll 创建多级父目录(dir != "." 时)
decisions.rationale: DoD error_handling[0] 要求嵌套路径 TempDir/a/b/prism.db 自动建目录;已加 TestOpenCreatesNestedParentDirs 覆盖

decisions.decision: schema 列名用 grp(非 group)
decisions.rationale: group 是 SQLite 保留字;Go 结构体字段仍为 Group,SQL 层映射 grp

decisions.decision: 在计划 4 用例外补 3 个 DoD 用例(UpsertInstrument/UpsertValuations 幂等 + Open 嵌套目录)
decisions.rationale: DoD boundary[0/1] 与 error_handling[0] 需显式覆盖,计划骨架未含

types.Instrument: struct{ Symbol, Type, Market, Name, Group, Source string }
types.ValuationRow: struct{ D string; PETTM, PB, PSTTM, Pctl5Y, Pctl10Y float64 }  // NaN=缺失
types.BoardRow: struct{ Instrument; AsOf string; PETTM, PB, Pctl5Y, Pctl10Y float64 }
types.SeriesData: struct{ Symbol, Name, Source string; Dates []string; PETTM, Pctl5Y, Pctl10Y []float64 }

funcs: func (s *Store) UpsertInstrument(inst Instrument) (int64, error)  // 幂等 by (symbol,type),返回 id
func (s *Store) LatestDate(instrumentID int64) (string, error)  // 无数据返回 ""
func (s *Store) UpsertValuations(instrumentID int64, rows []ValuationRow) error  // 幂等 by (instrument_id,d),单事务
func (s *Store) Board() ([]BoardRow, error)  // 每标的最新一行,ORDER BY grp,symbol
func (s *Store) Series(symbol, from string) (*SeriesData, error)  // from="" 全部,升序
